_game: COOM: Pitfall (Doom continual-RL suite; own scenario, not stock ViZDoom)
_note: Needs the TTomilin/COOM repo checked out somewhere and COOM_REPO set to it (or pass --coom-repo) -- the coom backend reads its conf.cfg/.wad scenario assets directly, it does not pip install the COOM package (which pins a conflicting gymnasium version).
_audio_note: Requires OpenAL (Ubuntu: sudo apt install libopenal1). Native stereo PCM at 44100 Hz, one Doom tic per step: keep fps=35. EFX reverb is explicitly disabled. --no-audio mutes playback but preserves logged PCM. MIDI music also requires a working engine MIDI renderer; check the engine startup log.
_keys_note: The coom backend derives its own default keymap from the scenario's 4 buttons (always TURN_LEFT, TURN_RIGHT, MOVE_FORWARD, plus one scenario-specific button). For pitfall that 4th button is JUMP -> SPACE. No 'keys' override needed here; other COOM scenarios get ATTACK/SPEED/USE mapped to SPACE/LSHIFT/E automatically.

text: Cross the corridor without falling into a pit.
The floor layout is randomized every episode.
